info.name: AInvestify API
info.description:
AI-driven sourcing, incubation, and fundraising-support pipeline for early-stage companies -- boutique-IB-style document packaging, not a fund screening deals for its own book. Lifecycle: **source** candidate companies -> a human **promotes** a lead into a deal -> **ingest** documents -> **extract** structured metrics with mandatory source citations -> **human review** -> **research** external corroboration -> **compile** a cited, reviewable document suite (CIM / teaser / pro-forma).

Every extracted numeric field carries a source citation or stays `null` -- never inferred from a typical value. Human review/sign-off is mandatory before any document is finalized. This system does not itself contact investors, negotiate terms, or run a raise -- that stays a human-led activity.

Phase 0: local-only, no auth, CORS open only to the local Vite dev server.

item.name: leads
item.description: Deal Sourcing Agent (§5.8): discover candidate companies, human keep/dismiss review, promote a kept lead into a real Deal. A lead never touches ExtractionResult until promoted.

request.description:
VC-style sourcing (agents/sourcing_agent.discover_leads): early-stage
candidates via GitHub/HN recency signals.

IB-style sourcing (agents/sourcing_agent.discover_ib_targets): mature/
public companies signaling a transaction window via SEC filings.

item.name: deals
item.description: Deal lifecycle writes: create a deal, sign the mandate, upload a document (ingestion), run extraction, read the audit log. GET list/detail live under `dashboard`; review decisions live under `review`.

request.description:
The raw ingested documents (with their DocBlocks) a deal's extraction
was built from -- named distinctly from GET /{deal_id}/documents
(api/routers/compilation.py), which lists the *compiled* memo suite
(CIM/teaser/proforma) instead. This is what a review screen's source-
citation drawer reads: a citation is a source_block_id, and this is the
only endpoint that can resolve one back to its actual content.

item.name: dashboard
item.description: Read-only deal summaries for the dashboard view.

item.name: review
item.description: Human Review Checkpoint (§5.5): per-field approve/edit/reject on an ExtractionResult, cap-table/funding-history block review, and the bounded 2-retry reject loop that re-invokes extraction with the reviewer's note.

item.name: research
item.description: Market Research Agent (§5.4): run live external-signal lookups for a deal, list findings, per-finding approve/reject, mark-reviewed.

item.name: compilation
item.description: Compilation Agent (§5.7): compile the CIM, the teaser's two-step draft + safe-to-send confirm, the pro-forma with an optional growth-rate override, rerun analytics, and fetch the resulting document suite.

request.description:
The document suite (plan §2): every version of every document type
by default, or every version of one type via ?document_type=teaser.

item.name: investors
item.description: Investor / demand-book record-keeping (§5.9 Roadshow stage). Pure record-keeping only -- this never contacts an investor or sends anything.

item.name: operations
item.description: Local operating workspaces for a shortlisted company: AI-prepared research/pitch/readiness drafts and evidence-backed reviews. No external sending, signing, or money movement.

item.name: prompt
item.description: Free-text directive classification -- the API-native equivalent of `main.py`'s CLI prompt router.
